html:
Вступ

Тихо світиться екран,
Пальці завмерли на мить.
Думка вже летить вперед,
А руки ще вчаться жить.
One key.
One finger.
One more try.
Just start typing.

Куплет 1

Ти дивишся вниз —
де та літера знов?
Думка вже поруч,
але не вистачає слів.
Backspace.
Again.
Ще один поворот.
А час собі йде,
і ніхто не чекає.
Don't hunt the keys.
Don't look down.
Keep your fingers
on the home row now.

Передприспів

Спочатку повільно,
спочатку не так.
A — S — D — F,
J — K — L.
Ще один рядок,
ще одна спроба.
And suddenly
your fingers know the road.

Приспів

Ти ще не за п'ятсот?
Не гальмуй!
Just type,
just type,
just type.
Не шукай клавіші —
start your ride.
Accuracy first,
then comes speed.
Твоя думка летить —
let your fingers lead.
Ти ще не за п'ятсот?
It's all right.
Не гальмуй.
Just type.

Куплет 2

Учора це були
лише букви й ряди.
Сьогодні вже слова
самі йдуть крізь пальці.
One word.
Two words.
One line more.
You don't need
to watch the keyboard anymore.
І раптом помічаєш:
ти дивишся лише вперед.
No looking down.
No stopping now.
The keyboard disappears,
and only thought remains.

Приспів

Не гальмуй!
Just type,
just type,
just type.
Не шукай клавіші —
start your ride.
Accuracy first,
then comes speed.
Твоя думка летить —
let your fingers lead.
Ти ще не за п'ятсот?
It's all right.
Не гальмуй.
Just type.

Бридж

Fast is not the beginning.
First comes control.
One key.
One finger.
Then let it flow.
Не треба чекати,
коли станеш крутим.
You become faster
because you keep moving.
Day by day.
Line by line.
Your hands remember.
Your mind is free.

Фінальний приспів

Ти ще не за п'ятсот?
Не гальмуй!
Typing Race —
come on, join the ride.
Accuracy first,
speed will come.
Keep on typing,
don't stop now.
Думка не має
чекати рук.
Let your fingers
follow your thought.
Ти ще не за п'ятсот?
Who cares tonight?
Put your hands on the keys.
And just type.
Just type.
Just type.

Кінцівка

One key.
One finger.
One more line.
No looking down.
No wasting time.
Треба лише
одного разу почати.
Just start typing.
And never look back.

Cicho świeci ekran,
palce czekają na znak.
Myśl już biegnie do przodu,
a dłonie uczą się jak.
One key.
One finger.
One more try.
Just start typing.

Куплет 1

Patrzysz w dół —
gdzie ta litera znów?
Myśl jest już gotowa,
lecz palce szukają słów.
Backspace.
Again.
Jeszcze jeden raz.
A czas płynie dalej,
nie zatrzyma się dla nas.
Don't hunt the keys.
Don't look down.
Keep your fingers
on the home row now.

Передприспів

Najpierw powoli,
nie zawsze bez błędów.
A — S — D — F,
J — K — L.
Jeszcze jedna linia,
jeszcze jedna próba.
And suddenly
your fingers know the road.

Nie zwalniaj!
Just type,
just type,
just type.
Nie szukaj klawiszy —
start your ride.
Accuracy first,
then comes speed.
Twoja myśl już leci —
let your fingers lead.
Jeszcze nie masz pięciuset?
It's all right.
Nie zwalniaj.
Just type.

Wczoraj były tylko
litery i rzędy.
Dzisiaj całe słowa
płyną już bez przerwy.
One word.

One line more.
You don't need
to watch the keyboard anymore.

patrzysz tylko przed siebie.
No looking down.
No stopping now.
Klawiatura znika,
zostaje tylko myśl.

html:
Вступ

The room is quiet.
The screen is bright.
Your hands are ready
for the typing light.
No need to panic.
No need to hide.
Place your fingers
and begin the ride.

Куплет 1

Left hand waiting,
right hand too.
Every key is
a path for you.
A, S, D, F —
stay in control.
J, K, L —
now feel the flow.
Don’t chase letters
all around.
Keep your hands
where they belong.
Look at the screen.
Trust the row.
One small movement —
then you go.

Приспів

Type on the keyboard,
key by key.
Let your hands learn
to move free.
Don’t look down,
keep your eyes ahead.
Your thoughts are faster
than the words you said.
Type on the keyboard,
don’t lose time.
One more word,
one more line.
Accuracy first,
speed will grow.
Keep on typing —
let your fingers know.

Куплет 2

Backspace happens.
That’s okay.
Fix the letter,
then move away.
Not a failure,
not the end.
Every mistake
can be your friend.
Slow at first,
then faster still.
Practice turns
into skill.
The keys grow quiet,
the screen stays clear.
Your hands remember
why you’re here.

Приспів

Type on the keyboard,
key by key.
Let your hands learn
to move free.
Don’t look down,
keep your eyes ahead.
Your thoughts are faster
than the words you said.
Type on the keyboard,
don’t lose time.
One more word,
one more line.
Accuracy first,
speed will grow.
Keep on typing —
let your fingers know.

Бридж

Home row steady.
Breathe in slow.
One key.
One move.
Let it flow.
No magic shortcut,
no secret door.
Just keep typing
a little more.
Day by day,
the distance fades.
Your mind creates,
your hands translate.

Фінальний приспів

Type on the keyboard,
feel the beat.
Thought and movement
finally meet.
No looking down,
no breaking pace.
Every new line
is a little race.
Type on the keyboard,
come alive.
Learn the rhythm,
start to fly.
Accuracy first,
speed will grow.
Keep on typing —
now you know.

Кінцівка

The screen is bright.
The keys are near.
Your hands are ready.
The path is clear.
One key.
One word.
One more try.
Type on the keyboard.
Let your thoughts fly.

права рука теж тут.

poczuj ten flow.

по всій клавіатурі.

спокійно, без напруги.

oczy przed siebie.

twoje palce wiedzą, gdzie biegnie.

Nie zwalniaj dziś.
One more word.
Ще один рядок.
Type on the keyboard,
відчуй свій ритм.
Pisz bez strachu,
keep moving with it.
Accuracy first,
Just type, just type —
і вперед, не зупиняйся.

Куплет 2

Backspace happens —
нічого страшного.
Popraw literę
і рухайся знову.
To nie porażka,
це частина гри.
Każdy błąd
навчає тебе йти.

рухи у love.
The keys grow quiet,
думка звучить ясна.
Nie patrz na klawiaturę —
твоя дорога вже власна.

Accuracy first,

Бридж

Home row steady.

Jeden klawisz,
рухайся впевнено.
No secret door,
nie ma skrótu w grze.
Ще один рядок —
і навичка росте.
Day by day,
dzień po dniu.
Твій розум створює,
a dłonie robią ruch.

Фінальний приспів

Type on the keyboard,
key by key.
Руки ready,
oczy free.
Не дивись вниз.
Nie zwalniaj dziś.
One more word.
Ще один рядок.
Typing Race —
це твій новий шлях.
Pisz szybciej,
але точність — твій знак.
Your thoughts can fly,
коли пальці ведуть.
Type on the keyboard —
і слова вже живуть.

Кінцівка

One key.
Один рух.
Jeszcze raz.
No looking down.
Не гай свій час.
Type on the keyboard.
Pisz, nie czekaj.
Набирай.

Just type,
just type,
just type.
Don’t search for keys —
start your ride.
Accuracy first,
then comes speed.
Your thought is already flying —
let your fingers lead.
Haven’t hit five hundred?
It’s all right.
Don’t slow down.
Just type.

Куплет 2

Yesterday there were only
letters and rows.
Today whole words
keep starting to flow.
One word.
Two words.
One line more.
You don’t need
to watch the keyboard anymore.
And then you realize
you are looking straight ahead.
No looking down.
No stopping now.
The keyboard disappears —
only the thought is left.

Приспів

Don’t slow down!
Just type,
just type,
just type.
Don’t search for keys —
start your ride.

then comes speed.

let your fingers lead.
Haven’t hit five hundred?
It’s all right.
Don’t slow down.
Just type.

Бридж

Fast is not the beginning.
First comes control.
One key.
One finger.
Then let it flow.
You don’t have to wait
until you are a master.
You become faster
because you keep moving.
Day by day.
Line by line.
Your hands remember.
Your mind is free.

Фінальний приспів

Haven’t hit five hundred?
Don’t slow down!
Typing Race —
come on, join the ride.
Accuracy first,
speed will come.
Keep on typing,
don’t stop now.
Your thoughts should never
wait for your hands.
Let your fingers
follow your mind.
Haven’t hit five hundred?
Who cares tonight?
Put your hands upon the keys.
And just type.
Just type.
Just type.

Кінцівка

One key.
One finger.
One more line.
No looking down.
No wasting time.
You only have to
begin one day.
Just start typing.
And never look back.

ВСТУП

The screen is glowing softly,
your fingers wait for a sign.
Your thoughts are already moving,
your hands are learning in time.
One key.
One finger.
One more try.
Just start typing.

КУПЛЕТ 1

You look down —
where is that letter now?
Your thought is ready to fly,
but your fingers don’t know how.
Backspace.
Again.
One more time.
And time keeps moving forward,
it will not wait in line.
Don’t hunt the keys.
Don’t look down.
Keep your fingers
on the home row now.

ПЕРЕДПРИСПІВ

At first, go slowly,
mistakes may come along.
A — S — D — F,
J — K — L.
One more line,
one more try.
And suddenly
your fingers know the way.
